fields.ability1_cost: Intelligence + Technology; no Mana cost; CPU capacity 30%
fields.ability1_effect: Activate a program by rolling Intelligence + Technology and taking its listed CPU load. Tizian's base pool is 3 + 1 = 4d6, doubled to 8d6 when his Programming specialization applies. Nanomancy has no Mana cost. His CPU is full at 30% total load: three 10% programs use 100% of his personal capacity. Attempting another program while full requires a Nanomancy roll; failure causes 1 Wisdom damage and Paralyzed for 1 round. Ending a program frees its CPU immediately. A short rest can clear all active programs. Cannot be combined with Magical Ritual.
fields.ability2_cost: Action; Intelligence + Technology; 10% CPU; 30 m; no Mana
fields.ability2_effect: Send nanites at one enemy within 30 m. Deal 2 damage, ignoring armor. Roll Intelligence + Technology to activate. No duration is stated in the program entry.
fields.ability3_effect: Roll Intelligence + Technology to activate. When using a discipline to heal someone, also heal 1 additional point in another attribute. This supplements the healing discipline check; it is not a replacement for that check. No duration is stated in the program entry.

fields.background:
Tizian's enthusiasm for technology caught the GDA's attention and led to his recruitment into its experimental nanomachine programme. He became one of the early candidates to have a nanocore implanted directly into his body. Now assigned to a commanding officer, he must field-test the technology under real operational conditions.

For Tizian, the assignment is a step towards a future in which nanomachines can help everyone. He wants to prove that the technology can be trusted, even under the most demanding circumstances.

GOAL: Make nanomachines stable and reliable enough to become widely available.

WEAKNESS: Tizian struggles to recognise the drawbacks of technological innovation and can rarely resist the latest gadget.
fields.campaign_notes:
PLAYING ADVICE
Keep the team going: Invest in nanoprograms that heal physical damage.

Solve technical problems: Develop abilities that help you examine, repair, and influence technology.

Manage your workload: Choose the programs you need for the situation and keep track of your CPU load.

NEXT STEPS
Healing Protocol enhances a healing discipline check; it does not replace Medicine. Consider Repair Protocol as a later purchase. The exoskeleton and implants are class equipment, not extra abilities: Techno Knight has not been selected.

BETA / GM NOTES
Nanomancy uses Intelligence + Technology and has no Mana cost. CPU capacity is Intelligence x 10% = 30%. The overload limit is 100% of that personal capacity: three programs at 10% fill Tizian's CPU. At full capacity, attempting another program requires a Nanomancy roll; failure causes 1 Wisdom damage and Paralyzed for 1 round. The author has corrected the class weapon to Short Sword + Sharp Rune: its 2 rune slots hold the rune, and damage is 3 + 1 = 4 Slashing.

ADDITIONAL EQUIPMENT
Exoskeleton Implant: Allows connection to and activation of powered exoskeleton armor.

The complete prebuilt class equipment is retained. Carrying-slot accounting and any beta exceptions should be agreed with the GM. No spare equipment points or bonus XP have been added.
